title: Washington workers' comp insurance average premium will rise about 4.9% in 2026 (news release 25-32)
issuer: Washington State Department of Labor & Industries

passages.question: When did the 2026 rates start, and what is the premium measured on?
passages.excerpt: The average cost of workers' compensation insurance in Washington for 2026 will go up 4.9 percent ... Starting Jan. 1, employers and workers together will pay, on average, $1.37 a week more for each full-time position. ... The 4.9 percent increase is an average for all industries. ... Washington's workers' compensation premiums are based on hours worked by the worker. When wages go up in Washington, employer and worker contributions stay the same.
